nodes.title: Prompt: rewrite the scene sentences only
widgets_values: Edit <Picture 1> into one ultra photorealistic photograph of the same person. One person only. Keep their face, their skin, their age and their hair exactly. Waist-up in a sunlit cafe, smiling at the lens, wearing a cream cable-knit sweater, soft window light from the left. Sharp skin detail, no text, no watermark. <Picture 2> is a close-up of the face in <Picture 1>. Match the face, the skin and the age exactly as they appear in both pictures.

widgets_values:
## H3 Image: realism edit (v2.0)
1. **Picture 1**: the photo to edit (the person or product).
2. **Picture 2**: a tight crop of the face from Picture 1 (head and some hair, 1024 px or more if the photo allows). It is the biggest likeness gain we measured.
3. **Prompt**: keep the first three sentences and the last three. Replace the scene in between: framing, pose, action, expression, clothing, place, light.
4. Pick the aspect ratio and megapixels (16–64 MP practical; 96 MP verified clean ceiling), then **Run** (Ctrl+Enter).

**Why it looks real:** H3 only draws photographic detail at 16+ MP. **H3 Realism KSampler** defaults to **Spectral 6** (6 model calls): plain Euler on the early layout steps, then 2D FFT frequency-split re-noising that locks low-frequency face proportions, hands and props while refreshing high-frequency skin and fabric detail. Switch `mode` to `spectral + texture 8` for maximum micro-detail.

**Seed:** on the sampler; each queue takes a new one. To refine a good result, drag it back into ComfyUI (it carries its workflow and seed), set the seed to fixed and change only the prompt.

**Time:** about 20–35 s per 16 MP edit on an RTX PRO 6000 (96 GB).

widgets_values:
**Tips**
- Very strong expressions (shouting, crying) drift identity the most.
- More pictures: add them to the next free image slot on the Prompt node and name them in the prompt as `<Picture 3>`, `<Picture 4>`. Shrink extra pictures to about 1024 px: in tests that was better for likeness, and faster.
- Printed text on clothing can look pasted on, or come out ghosted or misspelled depending on the seed: check it at 100%. Describing it helps ("screen-printed, following the folds of the fabric").
- New text in the shot (a sign, a name badge): write it in quotes in the scene, and change `Sharp skin detail, no text, no watermark.` to `Every letter of that text is spelled exactly as written and sharply readable. Sharp skin detail, no other text, no watermark.`
- Products: disconnect Picture 2 and use `Edit <Picture 1> into one ultra photorealistic product photograph. [the scene] Keep the product, its shape, its colours, its label and every letter of its printed text exactly as in <Picture 1>, sharp and readable. Sharp detail, no added text, no watermark.`
- The LoRA loader (top right) is off. In our tests a character LoRA added no likeness on top of the pictures and made skin smoother and hair glossier; if you use one, keep it at 0.5 or lower.

widgets_values: **H3 Realism KSampler** (comfyui-h3-sampler v2.0, github.com/igorls/comfyui-h3-sampler): runs plain Euler on H3's distilled 6-step grid for layout, then variance-preserving 2D FFT frequency-split re-noising on steps 2–4 (`spectral 6`, 6 calls — faster and higher edit likeness than v1.1) or adds exponential Heun texture on steps 4–5 (`spectral + texture 8`, 8 calls). Uses the uniform `H3Realism*` node IDs so it installs cleanly alongside other H3 node packs. Without the pack, use the RES4LYF version of this workflow.
